changelog: Phase 4 - polish + delighters. New Getting Started checklist on the main dashboard walks new users from connecting a mailbox to their first send. Auto-hides when done and can be dismissed manually. New Audit Log page under Admin shows every admin action ever taken - who did what to whom, when, from which IP. Filterable by action type and paginated. Also fixed a redirect loop on the /welcome page that could bounce users between login and welcome, and impersonation now sets the session cookie so the impersonated view actually works with the new cookie-based auth.
